headline: Siemens reports 5% rise in Q2 profit to Rs 504 crore
hook: Strong order book growth at Siemens
summary: Siemens Limited posted a consolidated net profit of Rs 504 crore for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, marking a 4.78% increase from Rs 481 crore a year ago. Revenue from operations grew to Rs 5,734 crore compared to Rs 4,900 crore in the corresponding period last year. New orders surged 38% year-over-year to reach Rs 6,228 crore. For an Indian retail investor, this signals steady industrial demand and revenue expansion for a major engineering stock.
why_it_matters: Order inflows signal robust industrial demand for Siemens.

headline: Siemens Q2 net profit rises 4% to Rs 504 crore on strong infrastructure demand
hook: Margins compress despite double-digit revenue growth
summary: Siemens Ltd reported a 3.9% year-on-year increase in second-quarter net profit to Rs 504 crore, driven by robust infrastructure and private capital expenditure. Revenue surged 17% to Rs 5,734 crore, while new orders jumped 37.8% to Rs 6,228 crore. However, EBITDA margin contracted to 10.9% from 12.4% due to higher material costs and commodity and foreign exchange volatility. Retail investors should note that strong order inflows highlight robust industrial demand, even as cost pressures weigh on profitability.
why_it_matters: Higher material costs squeeze margins despite strong order inflows
winners_losers: Infrastructure plays gain / margin-sensitive industrials hurt
